metadata.question: In January 2021, did Nambia experience over 7 inches of rainfall?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: CHIRPS rainfall data (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) - daily precipitation - Date: January 2021 (2021-01-01 to 2021-01-31) - Location: Namibia country boundary 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for CHIRPS (it's a precipitation product, not satellite imagery) - Simply sum all daily precipitation values for January 2021 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Total rainfall is a valid number (could be very low, which is expected in some parts of Namibia) - C1: If no images found in collection - C2: If valid pixels count is 0 after processing - C3: If result is None/NaN - 7 inches = 177.8 mm (need to convert) - Answer A if total >= 177.8 mm, B if < 177.8 mm ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const namibia = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Namibia')) .geometry(); const startDate = '2021-01-01'; const endDate = '2021-02-01'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(namibia); const imageCount = chirps.size().getInfo(); console.log(`CHIRPS Images found: ${imageCount}`); if (imageCount === 0) { console.log('No data for January 2021.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum all daily precipitation const totalPrecip = chirps.select('precipitation').sum(); // 4. Calculation - Get mean precipitation across Namibia const stats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: namibia, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const pixelCount = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: namibia, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const count = pixelCount.precipitation; const meanPrecip = stats.precipitation; console.log(`Valid pixels: ${count}`); if (count === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (meanPrecip === null || meanPrecip === undefined || isNaN(meanPrecip)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const thresholdMM = 177.8; // 7 inches in mm console.log(`Mean total rainfall in Namibia (Jan 2021): ${meanPrecip.toFixed(2)} mm`); console.log(`Threshold (7 inches): ${thresholdMM} mm`); if (meanPrecip >= thresholdMM) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
